title: Stogumber Wellington Memorial
location_name: Church of Our Lady, Stogumber, Somerset
memorial_details: Stone tablet to P/O C.H. Mardon inside the Church of Our Lady, Stogumber, Somerset.
narrative: Wellington DV593 of 150 Squadron, coded JN-?, departed Snaith at 2135 on 14 May 1942 for Dortmund. The aircraft was shot down at 0207 on 15 May by Obergefreiter Georg Worch of 9/NJG2, his first claim. All crew were killed.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Ogefr Georg Worch (9/NJG2), his 1st claim
notes: Post states KIA 15/04/42 and departure 14/05/42 — internal date conflict. Chorley BCL Vol 3 and Boiten NCA Early Years Pt 2 cited; verify dates before publishing.
